name: wds_vtab-svhn
description: wds_vtab-svhn is a WebDataset/VTAB-style variant of the SVHN digit recognition dataset intended for few-shot and transfer-evaluation of visual models. It measures models' ability to classify street-view house number digits under real-world imaging conditions and domain shifts. The benchmark is used in contrastive/zero-shot and fine-tuning evaluations of image encoders.
reputation: SVHN is a long-standing, widely used benchmark for digit recognition and domain-transfer experiments; this wds/VTAB variant is commonly used in CLIP/representation evaluations.
